core.title: Offset Self-Closing Cabinet Hinges, Acorn AJ3BQ

text.description_html:
Acorn AJ3BQ, 3/8" Offset Semi-Concealed Self Closing Hinge

Using a self closing hinge allows the cabinet door to swing closed by itself once you let go. Traditionally two or 3 of these will be used per door, depending on its size and weight. The Acorn made Self-Closing Cabinet Hinge can also eliminate the need for a clasp or hook to keep the door closed, allowing for a smooth, hands free appearance.

Specifications of the Self-Closing Smooth Iron Cabinet Hinges:

  • Finish: Smooth Black Iron
  • Height: 2-5/8"
  • 3/8" Offset Hinge -- Door face sits 3/8" out from the door frame.

Priced and sold as a pair (2-hinges)
